newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha holds steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha holds steady in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE naphtha markets were holding steady in quiet trade on Monday with crude off morning highs but still carrying supportive 30 cent gains in late trade, traders said.
They said business was very thin with buyers staying scarce and sellers reluctant to offer into the void for fear of pushing prices down further.

Avails continued to look lengthy but assessments of sellers' levels remained notional around $220 but no firm offers were seen. Relaxed buying interest from the petrochemical sector saw best bids around $216-$217 a tonne cif NWE.
